question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**than**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate option for the given blank is '**than**'.
 
• It means **'used when you are comparing two things'.** (दो वस्‍तुओं की तुलना के लिए प्रयुक्त)
 
 
• *Example: He’s taller **than** me.*</
